## Summary

Describe the dashboard, SQL, documentation, or data change.

## Validation

- [ ] Recorded the Power BI Desktop version and source file
- [ ] Checked data types, nulls, duplicates, and date parsing
- [ ] Tested affected visuals or SQL statements
- [ ] Included screenshots for visual changes
- [ ] Confirmed no private data, credentials, or unlicensed assets were added

## Assumptions and lineage

Document source, transformations, filters, and known limitations.
